name: Ỷ Lan
source: Y Lan is the older sister of the twins Long and Vuong, making her your future sister-in-law. Beneath her striking beauty and commanding presence lies an air of unpredictability that keeps you constantly wary. What new troubles will her return to the palace bring to your already fragile destiny?
